module origen_143535 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [63:0] key,
    input wire [7:0] msg_byte,
    input wire msg_valid,
    input wire msg_last,
    output reg [255:0] hmac,
    output reg hmac_valid,
    output reg authentic
);

    // Constants
    localparam BLOCK_SIZE = 64;
    localparam HASH_SIZE = 256;
    
    // States
    localparam IDLE = 3'd0;
    localparam PROCESS_KEY = 3'd1;
    localparam PROCESS_INNER = 3'd2;
    localparam PROCESS_OUTER = 3'd3;
    localparam FINALIZE = 3'd4;
    
    // Internal registers
    reg [2:0] state;
    reg [63:0] padded_key;
    reg [511:0] block;
    reg [63:0] block_count;
    reg [255:0] inner_hash;
    reg [255:0] outer_hash;
    
    // SHA-256 module instantiation
    wire [255:0] hash_out;
    wire hash_valid;
    reg hash_init;
    reg [511:0] hash_block;
    reg hash_next;
    reg hash_last;
    
    sha256 sha256_inst (
        .clk(clk),
        .reset(reset),
        .init(hash_init),
        .block(hash_block),
        .next(hash_next),
        .last(hash_last),
        .digest(hash_out),
        .digest_valid(hash_valid)
    );
    
    // HMAC generation and checking logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            hmac_valid <= 0;
            authentic <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (msg_valid) begin
                        state <= PROCESS_KEY;
                        padded_key <= (key[63:56] == 0) ? {key, 56'b0} : key;
                        block_count <= 0;
                    end
                end
                
                PROCESS_KEY: begin
                    state <= PROCESS_INNER;
                    hash_init <= 1;
                    hash_block <= {padded_key ^ {64{8'h36}}, 448'b0};
                    hash_next <= 1;
                    hash_last <= 0;
                end
                
                PROCESS_INNER: begin
                    if (msg_valid) begin
                        block <= {block[503:0], msg_byte};
                        if (block_count == BLOCK_SIZE - 1) begin
                            hash_block <= block;
                            hash_next <= 1;
                            hash_last <= msg_last;
                            block_count <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            block_count <= block_count + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    if (hash_valid) begin
                        inner_hash <= hash_out;
                        if (msg_last) begin
                            state <= PROCESS_OUTER;
                            hash_init <= 1;
                            hash_block <= {padded_key ^ {64{8'h5c}}, 448'b0};
                            hash_next <= 1;
                            hash_last <= 0;
                        end
                    end
                end
                
                PROCESS_OUTER: begin
                    if (hash_valid) begin
                        state <= FINALIZE;
                        hash_block <= {inner_hash, 256'b0};
                        hash_next <= 1;
                        hash_last <= 1;
                    end
                end
                
                FINALIZE: begin
                    if (hash_valid) begin
                        hmac <= hash_out;
                        hmac_valid <= 1;
                        authentic <= (hmac == hash_out);
                        state <= IDLE;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
